verdict.rationale: Evidence shows settlement-related building blocks (batch closing/settlement per docs-5, payout visibility per docs-10, webhooks for event notifications per docs-4, and a hosted reporting console per docs-14) but nothing documents automated per-seller and rolled-up reconciliation reports, scheduled delivery, or finance-stack-consumable file/API exports. missing for 10: explicit reconciliation/settlement report generation, per-seller vs rolled-up aggregation, scheduled file exports or dedicated reporting API endpoints for finance systems.
